name: Hints of a New Plague?
summary: At Go'Shek Farm, Quae and Kin have watched for days. Kin saw a courier leave a small house to the south, and they suspect she carries notes to Tarren Mill. Quae asks if you are a skilled tracker and wants the documents.

sections.title: Watching the Farm
sections.body: Quae expected Phin Odelic to send you, since he worries too much. Quae and Kin have watched the farm for days. Kin recently saw a courier leave a small house to the south. Kin talks often, but Quae trusts Kin's senses in dangerous places.

sections.title: The Courier's Folder
sections.body: Quae asks if you are a skilled tracker. The courier may carry notes bound for Tarren Mill, and the documents could shed light on what is happening in Hillsbrad. You are to find the Forsaken Courier and bring her Sealed Folder to Quae near Go'Shek Farm. While you search, Kin spots an apothecary leaving that same house. Quae suspects the apothecary is up to no good, but needs proof before anyone acts rashly.

faq.q: Who sent you to find Quae and Kin?
aliases: who started hints of a new plague
faq.answer: Phin Odelic sent you to check on Quae and Kin. Quae expected it, since Phin worries too much.

faq.q: Where did the courier come from?
faq.answer: Kin saw the courier leave a small house to the south.
Quae and Kin suspect the courier carries notes bound for Tarren Mill.

faq.q: What item are you sent to retrieve?
aliases: what item does the courier have
faq.answer: You are to bring the Forsaken Courier's Sealed Folder to Quae near Go'Shek Farm.

faq.q: Who else was spotted at the house?
aliases: who came out of the house
faq.answer: While you were away, Kin spotted an apothecary leaving the same house to the south.

faq.q: Why does Quae want the documents?
faq.answer: The documents might shed light on what is happening in Hillsbrad. Quae needs proof before anyone acts rashly.
